授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: The term “transformation design” (Burns, Cottam, Vanstone, & Winhall, 2006), has been associated with work within communities for socially progressive outcomes, as well as with work within organisations to introduce human-centred design cultures. Transformation design aims at radical change through design for services and society as a means of continually responding, adapting, and innovating in reaction to current issues.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: トランスフォーメーション・デザインは本質的に学際的である。サービスと社会のためのデザインの交差点に位置し、組織とコミュニティの設定の中で変化を生み出すトランスフォーメーション・デザインは、社会とサービスの両方のデザインにおける学生の知識を強化するため、戦略的デザインにおける現在の科目を補完する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Transformation design is essentially interdisciplinary. Situated in the intersection of design for services and society, creating change within organisational and community settings, transformation design will supplement the current subject offer in Strategic Design as it will enhance students’ knowledge in both social and service design.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Transformation Design, Change, Change, Power, Empathy, Assessment
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: The subject is taught and presented in English. Students may write in Japanese (or other languages). Translation tools such as DeepL will be used to support intercultural communication.
